items.title: 10.1 Oxidation, reduction aur redox reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.1 with the chapter opening, printed pages 212-213.

blocks.text: Chemistry ki woh shakh jo bijli (electrical) aur kimiyai (chemical) energy ke aapas mein badalne se bahas karti hai, bijli ki energy kimiyai energy mein aur kimiyai energy bijli ki energy mein, electrochemistry kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Oxidation aur reduction
blocks.text: Oxidation woh amal hai jis mein ek ya zyada electrons khoye jate hain; reduction woh amal jis mein ek ya zyada electrons hasil kiye jate hain.

Fe2+ se Fe3+ + e- aur Zn se Zn2+ + 2e- oxidations hain: Fe2+ aur Zn ne electrons khoye. Cl2 + 2e- se 2Cl- aur Cu2+ + 2e- se Cu reductions hain: Cl aur Cu2+ ne electrons hasil kiye. Oxidation aur reduction hamesha saath hote hain, aur jin reactions mein yeh hota hai woh redox reactions kehlate hain. Photosynthesis, jo poore sayyare ko khurak deti hai, aur respiration, jo aap ko zinda rakhti hai, dono redox reactions hain. Kisi reaction mein koi madda oxidise hua ya reduce, yeh jaanne ke do tareeqe hain: electron ki muntaqili (transfer), aur oxidation number ki tabdeeli.

blocks.prompt: Electron transfer ke lihaz se oxidation aur reduction ki tareef misalon ke saath karein (Quick Check 10.1a).
blocks.explanation: Oxidation electrons ka khona hai: Zn se Zn2+ + 2e-, Fe2+ se Fe3+ + e-. Reduction electrons ka hasil karna hai: Cu2+ + 2e- se Cu, Cl2 + 2e- se 2Cl-. Ek species ke khoye hue electrons doosri hasil karti hai, to dono hamesha redox reaction mein saath hote hain.

items: Electrochemistry: bijli aur kimiyai energy ka aapas mein badalna.

Oxidation = electrons khona (Fe2+ se Fe3+, Zn se Zn2+); reduction = hasil karna (Cl2 se Cl-, Cu2+ se Cu); redox reaction mein hamesha saath; electron transfer ya oxidation number ki tabdeeli se pehchane jate hain.
